name: Vault Fill
description: Types saved passwords into the browser without the model seeing them.

display_description.en: Signs in to websites with your saved logins without the AI ever seeing the password.
display_description.zh: 使用你已保存的网站登录信息自动登录，AI 在整个过程中始终看不到密码，只看到占位符，密码只会被填入匹配的网站。

display_description.en: Replaces password placeholders in browser actions with the saved value.
display_description.zh: 在浏览器操作中把密码占位符替换为已保存的值。

default_init_input.en: Sign in to my test portal with my saved login.
default_init_input.zh: 用我保存的登录信息登录测试门户。

quick_inputs.en: Sign in to my test portal with my saved login.
quick_inputs.zh: 用我保存的登录信息登录测试门户。

quick_inputs.en: Which sites do I have saved logins for?
quick_inputs.zh: 我为哪些网站保存了登录信息？

quick_inputs.en: Log in and download my latest invoice.
quick_inputs.zh: 登录并下载我最新的发票。
